1	# Moneo
2	
3	Moneo is an open-source personal finance app that runs on your own computer. Import bank statements or sync your bank, track accounts and wealth, plan spending, and ask questions about your money in chat or on a voice call. Figures always come from your own records; the AI explains them and suggests changes that you accept.
4	
5	Everything stays on your computer. There are no accounts and no sign-in screen: one owner, one workspace. The only data that leaves your computer goes to the services you connect (your AI provider, and optionally your bank or Scalable Capital).
6	
7	## Install
8	
9	### Easiest: let an AI agent install it
10	
11	If you use an AI coding agent such as Claude Code or Codex, it can do the install for you with the `moneo-setup` skill that comes with Moneo. Open the agent in an empty folder and paste:
12	
13	> Clone https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo, then set it up by following .agents/skills/moneo-setup/SKILL.md in that repository.
14	
15	If you already downloaded Moneo, open the agent in the Moneo folder and say **"set up Moneo"**. The agent runs the commands, tells you what each step does, and asks you only for what it can't do itself, like installing Docker or entering your keys in Moneo. If it can control your browser or computer, it asks first and then does the clicking too. You type passwords and keys yourself.
16	
17	### Or install it yourself
18	
19	#### 1. Install the tools
20	
21	- [Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads)
22	- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org) version 22 or newer
23	- [Docker Desktop](https://docs.docker.com/get-docker/) (on Linux, Docker Engine with Compose)
24	
25	Start Docker Desktop and wait until it says it is running.
26	
27	#### 2. Download Moneo
28	
29	```sh
30	git clone https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo.git
31	cd Moneo
32	npm ci
33	```
34	
35	#### 3. Run the setup
36	
37	```sh
38	npm run setup
39	```
40	
41	This creates the database in Docker, makes all the passwords and secrets Moneo needs, and saves them in a file called `.env`. The first run downloads a few GB and takes several minutes; you need about 4 GB of free disk space. On Windows a security prompt may ask to install a local certificate: click **Yes** (it is only used for bank connections and only trusted on this computer).
42	
43	You never need to open or edit `.env`. Keep it private and don't delete it.
44	
45	#### 4. Start Moneo
46	
47	```sh
48	npm run build
49	npm start
50	```
51	
52	The build takes a few minutes the first time. Then open **http://localhost:3000**.
53	
54	#### 5. Turn on the AI
55	
56	Go to **Settings → Keys and connections → AI access** and choose one:
57	
58	- **Sign in with ChatGPT** to use your ChatGPT Go, Plus or Pro plan, or
59	- **Paste an OpenAI API key** ([create one here](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys)) and click **Save key**. Usage is billed to that key.
60	
61	Voice calls and dictation need the OpenAI API key. An OpenRouter key is optional (for other models).
62	
63	#### 6. Add your money
64	
65	- **Import** a CSV or Excel export from your bank, or
66	- connect your bank or Scalable Capital (optional, see below).
67	
68	That's it. Want it on your phone or tablet too? See [Use it from your phone or tablet](#use-it-from-your-phone-or-tablet-optional).
69	
70	## Everyday use
71	
72	- **Start Moneo:** `npm start` in the Moneo folder (Docker Desktop must be running).
73	- **Stop Moneo:** press `Ctrl+C`. The database keeps running in Docker; `docker compose stop` stops it.
74	- **Update Moneo:**
75	  ```sh
76	  git pull
77	  npm ci
78	  npm run setup
79	  npm run build
80	  npm start
81	  ```
82	  Your data and secrets are kept.
83	
84	While Moneo runs it does its background work by itself: scheduled summaries, and syncing your bank and Scalable about once a day. Anything missed while your computer was off runs shortly after you start Moneo.
85	
86	## Keys and connections
87	
88	Every key and outside service is set up in the app under **Settings → Keys and connections**. Keys are checked with the provider before they are saved, stored encrypted in your database, shown only by their last four characters, and can be replaced or removed at any time. The same section shows that the secrets made by `npm run setup` are in place.
89	
90	### Connect your bank (optional)
91	
92	Moneo syncs booked transactions and balances from EU banks (for example Revolut and Commerzbank) through [Enable Banking](https://enablebanking.com). It is free for personal use. Each sync is an ordinary import that you can review and undo.
93	
94	1. Sign up at the [Enable Banking control panel](https://enablebanking.com/cp/) and create an application in the **Production** environment.
95	2. Fill in the application form:
96	   - Redirect URL: `https://localhost:3443/api/bank/callback`
97	   - Privacy policy URL: `https://indkhan.github.io/Moneo/privacy.html`
98	   - Terms of service URL: `https://indkhan.github.io/Moneo/terms.html`
99	3. Let the control panel make the key pair, and keep the downloaded private key file (`<application-id>.pem`).
100	4. In the control panel, link your own bank accounts to the application. Only linked accounts can be synced.
101	5. In Moneo, go to **Settings → Keys and connections → Connected banks** (also on the Import page). Paste the application ID, paste the private key or upload the `.pem` file, and click **Save and check**.
102	6. Click **Choose a bank**, pick yours, click **Connect bank** and approve access at your bank.
103	
104	Bank consent usually lasts up to 180 days; Moneo shows a reconnect banner 7 days before it ends. Pending transactions are not synced. If Enable Banking says it rejected the return address, add the Redirect URL from step 2 to your application and try again.
105	
106	### Connect Scalable Capital (optional)
107	
108	1. In Scalable on the web, go to **Profile → Security → Agentic Investing** and turn on access (read-only is enough).
109	2. In Moneo, click **Connect Scalable Capital** under **Settings → Keys and connections** (also on the Import page) and log in to Scalable (with 2FA in the Scalable app).
110	
111	Moneo then reads your holdings, totals and cash every day and shows the portfolio on Wealth. No keys are needed.
112	
113	Artifact Pages and Home cards can show your Scalable portfolio, recent activity and watchlist. By default they use the last sync, the same figures as Wealth. Turn on **Live Scalable data in artifacts** in Settings → AI and your data to read Scalable each time one opens; that also allows quotes, charts and news for any security, but loads slower and needs Scalable to be reachable.
114	
115	### Use it from your phone or tablet (optional)
116	
117	Your phone becomes another screen on the Moneo running on this computer: same data, same ChatGPT, bank and Scalable connections. It is off until you turn it on, and nothing changes on this computer.
118	
119	1. Go to **Settings → Keys and connections → Phone and tablet** and click **Turn on**. Moneo tells you if it needs [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com/download) installed, a sign-in, or one approval for secure addresses.
120	2. On your phone or tablet, install Tailscale and sign in with the same account.
121	3. Scan the code in Settings, then choose **Add to Home Screen**.
122	
123	The address and code are your own, from your own Tailscale account. Only devices on your Tailscale network can reach Moneo, and they get in without a password, so don't use a network you share with other people. Leave Tailscale Funnel off: Moneo refuses traffic from the public internet.
124	
125	Keep this computer on and awake with Moneo running: on a laptop, stay plugged in and set closing the lid to do nothing. After a restart, start Docker and run `npm start` again. On Windows, `tailscale set --unattended=true` keeps Tailscale connected after a restart. New ChatGPT, bank and Scalable logins start on this computer, because those services only return to its address. On Linux, first run `sudo tailscale set --operator=$USER`.
126	
127	How it works, step by step: [docs/phone-access-deep-dive.html](docs/phone-access-deep-dive.html).
128	
129	## Good to know
130	
131	- Moneo only listens on `127.0.0.1`, so other devices on your network can't open it unless you turn on [phone and tablet access](#use-it-from-your-phone-or-tablet-optional).
132	- Your data lives in the Docker volumes `moneo_db-data` and `moneo_storage-data`. `docker compose down` keeps them; **`docker compose down -v` deletes all your data**.
133	- If ports 54321 or 54322 are already in use, add `API_PORT=` and `DB_PORT=` with free ports to `.env` and run `npm run setup` again.
134	
135	## Development
136	
137	Use `npm run dev` instead of build and start. See [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for how the project works.
138	
139	| Command | Purpose |
140	| --- | --- |
141	| `npm test` | Unit tests |
142	| `npm run lint` | ESLint |
143	| `npm run build` | Production build |
144	| `npm run test:e2e` | Playwright browser tests (see [e2e/README.md](e2e/README.md)) |
145	
146	Browser tests use a separate QA user, never the owner's workspace: `node --env-file=.env scripts/e2e-auth.mjs` creates it and saves its session, and `--reset` empties its workspace.
147	
148	## License
149

## Preserve user changes

Users may make edits in the code outside of the conversation.

If you detect a surprising change made in the meanwhile, don't overwrite it, assume it was intentional or ask for confirmation.

## Creating a video

If the user asks to make, create, or build a new video or composition, load [Create a new Remotion video](./remotion-create/REFERENCE.md), whether or not a Remotion project already exists.

## New project setup

If no Remotion project currently exists, load [Create a new Remotion project](./remotion-create/REFERENCE.md)

## React Markup Best Practices

If you are writing Remotion React Markup, load [Remotion Markup Best Practices](./remotion-markup/REFERENCE.md)

## Maps

For static maps, animated routes and markers, geographic explainers, Mapbox, MapLibre, MapTiler, GeoJSON, or 3D geographic flyovers, load [Remotion Maps](./remotion-maps/REFERENCE.md).

## Multimedia

For achieving multimedia tasks in the browser, such as trimming, cropping videos, or getting metadata from them, load [Remotion Multimedia](./remotion-multimedia/REFERENCE.md)

## Improving Interactivity

By structuring the Remotion markup well, we can allow users to interactively change things in the Studio and write back to code. If relevant: [Interactivity Best Practices](./remotion-interactivity/REFERENCE.md)

## Open the preview

If the user asks to "make" a video, "create" a video, etc.
Don't render the video by default unless they are very explicit. They want to instead see an interactive preview.
As soon as the project can run, start Studio and open the preview in the browser before building or editing the composition. Keep it open while you work so the user can watch progress and steer.

### If you are using Cursor

Run Studio without `--no-open` so it opens the browser automatically:

```bash
npx remotion studio
```

### If you are using another agent client with an in-app browser

You can use the command above to let Studio open the browser, or run:

```bash
npx remotion studio --no-open
```

This will start a long-running process and print the server URL for the preview.  
If the server is already started, it will print the URL.
If you use `--no-open`, open the exact printed URL in the in-app browser and verify that Studio loads. Once a composition exists, verify that its video preview loads. If you cannot open it there, run Studio without `--no-open`.
You can visit a specific composition by navigating to `/[composition-id]`, for example `http://localhost:3000/MapAnimation`.

:::note
The Studio supports WebMCP tools.
:::

### If you do not have an in-app browser

This will open the Studio in the browser or refocus it if it is already open.

```bash
npx remotion studio
```

### More options

To launch a project in Remotion Studio, open its exact local URL, or configure Studio CLI flags, load [Remotion Studio](./remotion-studio/REFERENCE.md).

The video is ready for you to watch: 45 seconds, 1080p at 60fps, with sound. I checked sampled frames, but I can't hear audio or watch it in motion. For sound I only confirmed the levels are healthy (peaks about −2 dB), so your ears are the real test.

![Moneo promo](C:\Users\mgsuk\.t3\worktrees\Moneo\t3-8c7e6a34\promo\out\moneo-promo.mp4)

Every cut lands on a 140 BPM track that I generated from code, so there's no music licensing to worry about.

| Section | What happens on screen |
|---|---|
| **Hook** | "Spreadsheets", "Six bank apps" and "Lost receipts" get crossed out, then "What if you could just **call** your money?" Moneo rings and the cursor answers. |
| **Call it** | The question hits word by word over the orb, two tasks run at once, then a full-screen "Yes." and €3,180. You tap to add the €42 card. |
| **See it** | The camera whips from net worth to accounts to "Waiting for you", then pulls out as bank and import syncs pop in. |
| **Budget it** | Full-screen budget bars slam in one per beat, and the €42 from the call lands in Eating out. |
| **Plan it** | The camera rides the forecast line through the Lisbon dip, then a what-if slider lifts the whole year. |
| **Build it** | A prompt types itself, a Scalable page assembles, and dragging a slider swells the chart past €1M. It ends with three artifact cards on Home. |
| **Trade it** | A Scalable order preview, a tap on Buy, then "Only your tap sends it." |
| **Power it** | A giant "Sign in with ChatGPT" button, then "You're in." |
| **Feature wall** | Twelve more features at one every half beat, such as bank sync, agents and phone access, and the picture flips to light mode on "Light and dark". |
| **Own it** | "Your computer. No accounts. Open source." ending on the logo and GitHub link. |

- **Voice:** the call shows big captions rather than a spoken voice. A real voice would make that scene much stronger, but it would mean a small paid text-to-speech call on your OpenAI key, so I didn't do it without asking.
- **Accuracy:** the figures are sample data and the end card says so. It also says data leaves only for services you connect, and the Power scene says voice calls need an API key, so the video doesn't overpromise.
- **Code:** the project is committed in `promo/`, and the app's type check and lint now skip that folder. I only ran the privacy check and the promo's type check; the app's tests, lint and build didn't run because that changed nothing in the app itself.

1	# Browser tests
2	
3	Playwright tests run against the app on http://localhost:3000. The config starts it (`npm run dev`, or the production build with `E2E_PRODUCTION_BUILD=1`) unless a server is already running there.
4	
5	## Setup
6	
7	1. Start the backend: `npm run setup`.
8	2. Create the QA user and save its session: `node --env-file=.env scripts/e2e-auth.mjs`. Its login is stored in `.env` as `E2E_USER_EMAIL`/`E2E_USER_PASSWORD`, and its session in `e2e/.auth.json` (or set `E2E_STORAGE_STATE`).
9	3. Before a full run, empty its workspace: `node --env-file=.env scripts/e2e-auth.mjs --reset`. Never delete the user.
10	
11	Tests never use the owner's workspace: a saved QA session takes the place of the owner's automatic sign-in.
12	
13	## Running
14	
15	```sh
16	npm run test:e2e -- --workers=1
17	```
18	
19	Use one worker: several specs change the same QA workspace and its preferences. Stop a running server on port 3000 before `npm run build`, so the two don't write `.next` at the same time.
20	
21	## Kinds of specs
22	
23	- `*.smoke.spec.ts` and `*.mocked.spec.ts` need no saved session; mocked specs stub API responses to check UI contracts.
24	- `*.gated.spec.ts` need the backend. Most use the QA session; others create disposable users with the service key, sign them in by session cookie, and remove them in `finally`. If interrupted, their IDs are left in ignored `.qa/` files for cleanup.
25	- `core-journey.gated.spec.ts` calls the real AI provider, so it costs money: run it only when you mean to.
26	- `review-runtime.config.ts` and `review-investigation.config.ts` run the real Workflow engine against local synthetic database and model servers (ports 3040/3041), including a server restart mid-review: `npx playwright test --config e2e/review-runtime.config.ts`.
27	
28	A skipped spec is not a pass: it means a prerequisite (backend, QA session, service key) is missing.
29	
30	## Acceptance
31	
32	`npm run acceptance:fast` runs unit tests, lint and the build. `npm run acceptance:required` then runs the SQL regressions, live database checks and the browser suite on that build with one worker. Results go to an ignored `.qa/acceptance-*` folder; logs there may contain workspace data, so keep them out of the repo.
33	
34	## Scalable
35	
36	`scalable-trading.gated.spec.ts` drives chat against a local stand-in for Scalable's MCP server (`e2e/mocks/scalable-mcp.mjs`, made-up data) with the real AI model. Start the app with `SCALABLE_MCP_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:3043` and run the spec with the same variable; the spec starts the stand-in, adds a Scalable connection to the QA workspace and removes it afterwards.
